stateNote: Bake in the oven at about 180°C for about an hour. After that, check it, give it a stir and check to see if the venison is cooked through. If it isn't, put it back in the oven for longer, checking every 10 mins or so. Once you're happy it's cooked, remove the lid from the casserole dish.
